quranTranslation.text: And enjoin upon thy people worship, and be constant therein. We ask not of thee a provision: We provided for thee. And the sequel is for righteousness.

explanation.bs: „I naređuj svojoj porodici (أَهْلَكَ) da klanja namaz“ – ukućani.
explanation.en: “And enjoin upon thy people [thy household] worship” — the household.

quranTranslation.text: Say: O People of the Scripture! Come to an agreement between us and you: that we shall worship none but Allah, and that we shall ascribe no partner unto Him, and that none of us shall take others for lords beside Allah. And if they turn away, then say: Bear witness that we are they who have surrendered (unto Him).

explanation.bs: „Reci: O sljedbenici Knjige (أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ), dođite…“ – ljudi jedne knjige.
explanation.en: “Say: O People of the Scripture! Come…” — the people of a scripture.

quranTranslation.text: And if the people of the townships had believed and kept from evil, surely We should have opened for them blessings from the sky and from the earth. But (unto every messenger) they gave the lie, and so We seized them on account of what they used to earn.

explanation.bs: „A da su stanovnici naselja (أَهْلَ الْقُرَى) vjerovali…“ – stanovnici mjesta.
explanation.en: “And if the people of the townships had believed…” — the inhabitants of a place.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran above (all His) creatures.

explanation.bs: „Allah je odabrao Adema, Nuha, porodicu Ibrahimovu i porodicu Imranovu“ – آل plemenitih.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran” — the house of the noble.

quranTranslation.text: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,

explanation.bs: „…osim Lutove porodice; njih ćemo, doista, sve spasiti“ – porodica poslanika.
explanation.en: “(All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one” — a prophet's household.

quranTranslation.text: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening; and on the day when the Hour upriseth (it is said): Cause Pharaoh's folk to enter the most awful doom.

explanation.bs: „Uvedite faraonov narod (آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ) u najžešću kaznu!“ – آل kao pristalice, ne samo rod.
explanation.en: “Cause Pharaoh's folk to enter the most awful doom” — آل as followers, not only kin.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

explanation.bs: „On vas opominje (يَعِظُكُمْ) da biste se prisjetili“ – nakon naredbe pravde i zabrane razvrata; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed” — after the command of justice and the forbidding of immorality; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers.

explanation.bs: „Allah vas opominje da nikada više ne ponovite nešto slično, ako ste vjernici“ – opomena koja odvraća.
explanation.en: “Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers” — an admonition that restrains.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when Luqman said unto his son, when he was exhorting him: O my dear son! Ascribe no partners unto Allah. Lo! to ascribe partners (unto Him) is a tremendous wrong -

explanation.bs: Lukman je opominjao sina: „Sinko moj, ne pripisuj Allahu druga!“
explanation.en: Luqmān, admonishing his son: “O my dear son! Ascribe no partners unto Allah.”

quranTranslation.text: And (Salih) turned from them and said: O my people! I delivered my Lord's message unto you and gave you good advice, but ye love not good advisers.

explanation.bs: Salih: „Prenio sam vam poslanicu svoga Gospodara i iskreno vas savjetovao, ali vi ne volite one koji iskreno savjetuju“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Ṣāliḥ: “I delivered my Lord's message unto you and gave you good advice, but ye love not good advisers” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and give good counsel unto you, and know from Allah that which ye know not.

explanation.bs: Nuh: „Dostavljam vam poslanice svoga Gospodara i iskreno vas savjetujem.“
explanation.en: Noah: “I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and give good counsel unto you.”

quranTranslation.text: Not unto the weak nor unto the sick nor unto those who can find naught to spend is any fault (to be imputed though they stay at home) if they are true to Allah and His messenger. Not unto the good is there any road (of blame). Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: Nema grijeha na slabima, bolesnima i onima koji nemaju čime da troše „ako su iskreni prema Allahu i Njegovom Poslaniku“ – ista riječ, iskrenost prema Allahu.
explanation.en: There is no blame on the weak, the ill and those without means to spend “if they are true to Allah and His messenger” — the same word, sincerity toward Allah.

quranTranslation.text: Work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering (thereof). and call on Him in fear and hope. Lo! the mercy of Allah is nigh unto the good.

explanation.bs: „I ne kvarite na Zemlji nakon što je ona uređena …“ – kvarenje kao narušavanje uspostavljenog reda.
explanation.en: “Work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering (thereof)” — corruption as the undoing of an order set right.

quranTranslation.text: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.

explanation.bs: „Rekla je: ‚Kad vladari uđu u neko naselje, unište ga, a ugledne njegove stanovnike učine poniženim …‘“ – riječi kraljice Sabe; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame” — the words of the Queen of Sheba; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice, and wrong not people in respect of their goods. And do not evil in the earth, causing corruption.

explanation.bs: „O narode moj, dajte potpunu mjeru i tačnu vagu, po pravdi, ne oštećujte ljude u onome što im pripada i ne činite zlo na Zemlji kao smutljivci“ – Šuajb: zakidanje na mjeri je zlo koje se prepoznaje sudom.
explanation.en: “O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice, and wrong not people in respect of their goods. And do not evil in the earth, causing corruption” — Shuʿayb: short measure is an evil recognised by judgement.

quranTranslation.text: And when Moses asked for water for his people, We said: Smite with thy staff the rock. And there gushed out therefrom twelve springs (so that) each tribe knew their drinking-place. Eat and drink of that which Allah hath provided, and do not act corruptly, making mischief in the earth.

explanation.bs: „… jedite i pijte od Allahove opskrbe i ne činite zlo na Zemlji kao smutljivci“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovu formulu.
explanation.en: “Eat and drink of that which Allah hath provided, and do not act corruptly, making mischief in the earth” — ar-Rāġib cites this formula.

quranTranslation.text: And on the day when the Hour riseth the guilty will vow that they did tarry but an hour - thus were they ever deceived.

explanation.bs: „A na Dan kad Čas nastupi, zločinci će se zaklinjati da nisu ostali više od jednog časa …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: prvi put Sudnji dan, drugi put kratko vrijeme.
explanation.en: “And on the day when the Hour riseth the guilty will vow that they did tarry but an hour” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: first the Day, then a short time.

quranTranslation.text: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

explanation.bs: „Čas se primakao, a mjesec se rascijepio na dva dijela“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za sāʿa kao ime Sudnjeg dana.
explanation.en: “The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for sāʿa as a name of the Day.

quranTranslation.text: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

explanation.bs: „Ne! Kunem se Danom ustajanja“ – sura nazvana tim imenom.
explanation.en: “Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection” — a surah named after it.

quranTranslation.text: And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the home of the scorners in hell?

explanation.bs: „A na Dan ustajanja vidjet ćeš one koji su o Allahu laž govorili s licima pocrnjelim …“ – stalni izraz yawm al-qiyāma.
explanation.en: “And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened” — the fixed phrase yawm al-qiyāma.

quranTranslation.text: What is the Calamity?

explanation.bs: „Šta je Udarač?“ – pitanje koje ističe strahotu; ar-Rāġib navodi početak sure.
explanation.en: “What is the Calamity?” — a question that stresses the dread; ar-Rāġib cites the opening of the surah.

quranTranslation.text: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.

explanation.bs: Semud i Ad su poricali Udarač – Sudnji dan nazvan po udarcu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Thamud and ʿĀd denied the Striking Calamity — the Day named for its blow; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The Reality!

explanation.bs: „Zbilja!“ – ar-Rāġib: dan na kojem nagrada postaje izvjesna.
explanation.en: “The Reality!” — ar-Rāġib: the day on which recompense becomes due.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!

explanation.bs: „Rekao je: ‚Musa, baci ga dolje!‘“ – obično bacanje: Musa po Allahovoj zapovijedi baca svoj štap; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “He said: Cast it down, O Moses!” — plain throwing: Moses throws down his staff at Allah's command; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when Allah laid a charge on those who had received the Scripture (He said): Ye are to expound it to mankind and not to hide it. But they flung it behind their backs and bought thereby a little gain. Verily evil is that which they have gained thereby.

explanation.bs: „… a oni su ga odbacili za leđa i trampili za sitnu dobit …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: odbačeno kao nešto do čega se ne drži.
explanation.en: “But they flung it behind their backs and bought thereby a little gain” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: thrown away as of no account.

quranTranslation.text: (One said): Kill Joseph or cast him to some (other) land, so that your father's favour may be all for you, and (that) ye may afterward be righteous folk.

explanation.bs: „Ubijte Jusufa ili ga zabacite u neku daleku zemlju, pa će lice vašeg oca biti samo vaše …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: bacanje koje udaljava.
explanation.en: Joseph's brothers say: kill Joseph, or cast him off into some land, so that their father's face is turned to them alone — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: throwing that puts far away.
